scripts.text:
[Killtin]
Ah yes, that's why you
look so familiar. You're
of those to whom I've taught
the ^990099Venom Knife^000000 skill. So, what
brings you to me this time?
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
啊，难怪眼熟，你跟我学过^990099毒刃^000000。
这次来有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
What's that...?!
You want me to teach
it to you once again?
It's a shame you've forgotten,
but I suppose it can't be helped. Alright, alright, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
什么...？！要我再教一次？
忘了虽可惜，也没办法。
行，再教你一遍。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
First, you need to equip
a Knife class weapon, and
then cast Envenom on your
knife. Throwing the blade?
That's all in the wrist. Now,
watch me closely and take note.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
先装备短剑类武器，用施毒给刀刃淬毒。
至于怎么掷出去，就看手腕的功夫。
仔细看，记好要领。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
You see? Having
good form is essential
to performing flawless
technique. Always basics
before the specifics. Now,
why don't you give it a try?
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
看见了吗？
姿势正确，招式才能使得完美。
先打基础，再谈细节。
来，你试试。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
Good... Very good...
Perfect form. Yes...
Hmm. Are you sure that
you forgot how to do this
skill? I suppose that all you
needed was a quick refresher.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
好...很好...姿势很标准。
嗯，你确定真忘了？
看来稍稍温习，就全想起来了。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
Alright, I think it's
safe to say that you've
mastered the Venom Knife
skill. Leave me now, and
always fight for the honor
of the Assassin Guild!
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
好，看来毒刃已经掌握了。
去吧，永远为刺客公会的荣誉而战！

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
So how has that
^990099Venom Knife^000000 skill
been working for you?
Be careful, and make sure
that your victims always
deserve what you give them!
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
^990099毒刃^000000用得怎么样？
小心些，出手前，务必确认对方罪有应得！

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
So you've learned all of
the specialized Assassin
skills, eh? Don't let yourself
become overconfident. Strive
for even greater strength for
the Assassin Guild's honor.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
刺客的专属本领都学会了？
可别自满，继续追求力量，为公会争光。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
So how has that
^990099Venom Knife^000000 skill
been working for you?
Be careful, and make sure
that your victims always
deserve what you give them!
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
^990099毒刃^000000用得怎么样？
小心些，出手前，务必确认对方罪有应得！

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
Hm? Ah, you're definitely
a member of the Assassin
Guild. Great, you've come
just at the right time.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
嗯？是刺客公会的人吧。
很好，来得正巧。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
Our guildmaster recently
succeeded in developing two
new skills for Assassins. I've
been charged with the task of
teaching these new skills to
all the members of our guild.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
会长最近创出了两项刺客新技能，我负责传授给公会的所有成员。

scripts.text: New skills?
scripts.translation: 新技能？

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
That's right, {0}.
The first skill specifically
enhances the Sonic Blow
skill, and the second skill
is a long range attack that's
named ''^990099Venom Knife^000000.''
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
没错，{0}。
第一个技能专门强化音速投掷，第二个技能是名为“^990099毒刃^000000”的远程攻击。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
If you have any questions,
feel free to ask me about
any of these new skills. It's
my job to teach you as much
as I can about them.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
关于新技能，有什么问题尽管问。
尽力把它们教明白，就是我的职责。

scripts.text: ^0000FFSonic Blow Enhancement^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF音速投掷强化^000000

scripts.text: ^990099Venom Knife^000000
Continue Conversation
scripts.translation: 继续对话

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
If you've been an Assassin
for a while, then you must
be familiar with the Sonic
Blow skill, which inflicts 8
powerful strikes at an enemy
in one blindingly fast attack.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
当刺客有些日子，就该熟悉音速投掷。
一瞬间连出8次重击，快得叫人看不清。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
However, due to the speed
involved in that skill, Sonic
Blow isn't as accurate as it
can be. After years of testing
and research, our guildmaster
developed a way to fix this.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
不过，出手太快，也就难免失了准头。
会长试验研究多年，总算找到了办法。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
He created a new skill
named ''Sonic Acceleration''
that Assassins can cast on
themselves in order to quickly
detect and accurately strike
the target's fatal points.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
他创出一项新技能，叫超音速投掷。
刺客对自身施展后，就能迅速找准并击中敌人的要害。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
In effect, Sonic Acceleration
roughly doubles the damage
that you can inflict with the
Sonic Blow. If you use Sonic
Blow pretty often, then this
skill will be pretty useful.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
有了超音速投掷，音速投掷的伤害大约能翻一倍。
经常使这招的话，肯定很实用。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
I suggest that you learn
the Venom Knife skill from
me first. Then, you can talk
to Esmille, the beautiful
Assassin Cross right next to me, to learn Sonic Acceleration.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
先跟我学毒刃吧。
再去找我旁边那位美丽的十字刺客艾斯米尔，学超音速投掷。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
As you may well know, our
job isn't really known for its
long range attacks. Sure, we
can use Bows, and we've got
a few long distance skills, but
their uses are kind of limited.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
你也知道，我们这职业不以远攻见长。
虽说能用弓，也有几招远程攻击，可用途终究有限。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
This Venom Knife skill was
developed with this weakness
in long range attacking in mind. Basically, we use the Envenom
skill on a knife and throw it at a distant enemy to poison them.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
毒刃就是为弥补远攻的不足而创的。
先用施毒给短剑淬毒，再掷向远处的敌人，使其中毒。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
Now, if you like, I can
teach you the ^009900Venom Knife^000000
skill right now. It won't take
that much time, so what do
you say? You ready to learn?
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
愿意的话，现在就能教你^009900毒刃^000000，花不了多少工夫。
怎么样，准备好学了吗？

scripts.text: Learn Venom Knife
scripts.translation: 学习毒刃

scripts.text: I d-don't wanna learn!
scripts.translation: 我、我不想学

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
First, you need to equip
a Knife class weapon, and
then cast Envenom on your
knife. Throwing the blade?
That's all in the wrist. Now,
watch me closely and take note.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
先装备短剑类武器，用施毒给刀刃淬毒。
至于怎么掷出去，就看手腕的功夫。

先打基础，再谈细节。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
Hey, that's pretty good.
You're catching on really
quick. Heh heh, but still,
I guess I can take a little
bit of credit for my excellent
instruction. Ah, very nice.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
嘿嘿，不错，领会得真快。
嘿嘿，当然也得算我教得好。
很好。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
Alright, you may need
to practice a bit more
of this skill, but for the most
part, you can use Venom
Knife pretty easily in battle.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
再多练练，便能熟能生巧。
不过现在，就已经足以在战斗中使出毒刃了。

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
Well, that's all I can
teach you. Use this skill
expertly, and bring woe to
your enemies for the honor
of the Assassin Guild!
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
能教的都教完了。
好好磨练，为刺客公会的荣誉，让敌人尝尝苦头！

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
Y-you don't want to
learn? Tough! It's my
job to teach this Venom
Knife skill to every member
of the Assassin Guild! You're^FFFFFFaaaaa^000000 not leaving until I tell you to!
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
不、不想学？
由不得你！
将毒刃教给每一位公会成员，是我的职责！
没我开口，你^FFFFFFaaaaa^000000就别想走！

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
You can't refuse an
order from our guildmaster...
Like it or not, this skill will
make you a better Assassin.
Trust me on this and just agree
to learn the skill, will you?
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
会长的命令，不能违抗...
不管愿不愿意，学会这招总能让你更进一步。
信我的，答应学吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Killtin]
A Thief...? Huh.
That's a respectable
job. But listen, if you
want me to be able to
teach you anything, you'll
need to get stronger first.
scripts.translation:
[基尔廷]
盗贼...？嗯，是个值得尊重的职业。
不过，若想跟我学本领，就得先练得更强。

[刺客]
...
继续走吧。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Mm? Ah, you've transcended
and become an Assassin Cross
as well. I understand the trouble that you must have gone through
to be reborn with new strength.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
嗯？你也转生成十字刺客了。
为了重生、获得新的力量，一定经历了不少磨难，我明白。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
You probably need to learn
the Sonic Acceleration skill
again after having lost some
of your memories. I truly
sympathize, and am willing
to teach it to you again.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
遗忘了部分记忆，得重学超音速投掷吧。
真不容易，我愿再教你一遍。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
First, go and learn the
Sonic Blow skill. The skill
I will teach you is completely
useless unless you learn how
to perform a Sonic Blow. I shall be waiting right here till then.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
先学会音速投掷吧，否则我要教的这招毫无用处。
我就在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Now, right before you
perform Sonic Blow, make
sure your feet are positioned
like this. Then, as smoothly
and quickly as possible, shift
your weight over to this side.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
施展音速投掷前，双脚要这样站。
然后，尽量平稳、迅速地将重心移向这一侧。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Watch carefully, this
is the most important
part. See where my hands
are and the angle of my
arms? This is the form that
you've got to memorize.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
仔细看，这步最重要。
手的位置、手臂的角度，看清了吗？
这姿势必须牢记。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Alright, that's all
you need to know. Now,
please try it so I can give
you feedback on your form.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
要领就这些，你试试看，我来指正动作。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Hmm, you're shifting
your weight kind of
unsteadily. It might
help if your center of
gravity was like this...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
嗯，转移重心时不太稳。
像这样调整一下，也许更好...

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Ah, you're so very
close to perfection.
Focus more on smoothly
transitioning from your
stance to executed action.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
快练成了。
再注意些，让起势到出招的衔接更流畅。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Yes, that's it...!
Very well executed.
Good work, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
对，就是这样...！
这招使得漂亮，{0}，干得好。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Do you understand now?
You should have no problem
remembering this skill now.
I can teach you nothing more,
so all I can do now is wish
you luck on your journeys.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
明白了吧？
这下应该记住了，我已没什么可教的。
祝你一路顺利。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
I trust that using
Sonic Acceleration in
battle has given you an
edge over the enemy. Bring
swift defeat to your foes for
the Assassin Guild's honor.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
有了超音速投掷，相信你已在战斗中占得先机。
为刺客公会的荣誉，迅速制敌吧。

So how is your little
mission coming along?
I trust that you've completed
that task I assigned for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
交给你的小任务，办得怎么样？
想必已经完成了吧。

scripts.text: How's this for treasure?
scripts.translation: 这件宝物怎么样

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Oh, that jewel...!
It's so captivating~
I haven't seen anything
so beautiful in such a long
time. You've done very well...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
哦，那颗宝石...！
真迷人~
许久没见过这么美的东西了，干得很好...

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
That jewel is yours
to keep. In truth, I don't
really need any treasure, just some proof of your qualification.
It looks like you're ready for me to teach you Sonic Acceleration.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
宝石你自己留着吧。
我并不缺宝物，只想看看你是否够资格。
看来可以教你超音速投掷了。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Find something valuable
Only the strong can explore
that area, so doing this will
prove your competency to me.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
找件值钱的东西。
那里只有强者才去得了，办到就能证明你的实力。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Find something valuable
for me by searching the
^FF0000Coffins^000000 in the Sphinx.
Only the strong can explore
that area, so doing this will
prove your competency to me.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
去斯芬克斯的^FF0000石棺^000000里，找件值钱的东西。
那里只有强者才去得了，办到就能证明你的实力。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Find something valuable
for me by searching the
^FF0000Stone Statues^000000 in the Sphinx.
Only the strong can explore
that area, so doing this will
prove your competency to me.
scripts.translation:

去斯芬克斯的^FF0000石像^000000处，找件值钱的东西。
那里只有强者才去得了，办到就能证明你的实力。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Find something valuable
in the ^FF0000flooded crypt in the
bottom floor^000000 of the Pyramids.
Only the strong can explore
that area, so doing this will
prove your competency to me.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
去金字塔^FF0000最底层被水淹没的墓穴^000000，找件值钱的东西。
那里只有强者才去得了，办到就能证明你的实力。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Ah. Hello, comrade.
Have you heard about
the latest news from
the Assassin Guild?
Ah, you've spoken to
Killtin. Good, good...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
你好，同伴。
听说公会的新消息了？
哦，跟基尔廷谈过了，好...

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Now, I've been charged
with the responsibility of
teaching the Sonic Acceleration skill to all interested Assassins.
I can tell you more about it if
Killtin didn't fully explain.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
我负责向愿意学习的刺客传授超音速投掷。
若基尔廷没说清，我可以再仔细讲讲。

scripts.text: Please tell me more...
scripts.translation: 请再讲讲

scripts.text: I want to learn Sonic Acceleration!
scripts.translation: 我想学超音速投掷

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Sonic Acceleration is
a ^FF0000support skill used in
conjunction with Sonic Blow^000000.
Assassins can only cast this
skill on themselves for their
own personal benefit.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
超音速投掷是^FF0000配合音速投掷使用的辅助技能^000000，只能对自己施展，增强自身能力。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
If you're familiar with
Sonic Blow, you'll know
that it's difficult to inflict
fatal damage with that skill.
It's far too fast to be able
to attack very accurately...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
熟悉音速投掷，就知道这招很难使出致命一击。
实在太快，难以准确击中...

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
However, by learning
Sonic Acceleration, you
can overcome this accuracy
drawback and fulfill the full
damage potential of the
Sonic Blow skill.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
学会超音速投掷，就能弥补准头不足的弱点，发挥音速投掷的全部威力。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
This skill is truly great.
And our guildmaster,
the one who invented this
skill, is also... He's a man
amongst men, I must say.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
真是绝妙的技能。
创出这招的会长，也是...不得不说，真正的男子汉。

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
Ah, I'm glad to see
that you're so enthusiastic
about learning this skill.
But first, there we need to
take care of the prerequisites...
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
很高兴你如此热心求学。
不过，先得满足一些条件...

scripts.text:
[Esmille]
First, go and learn the
Sonic Blow skill. The skill
I will teach you is completely
useless unless you learn how
to perform a Sonic Blow. I shall be waiting right here till then.
scripts.translation:
[艾斯米尔]
先学会音速投掷吧，否则我要教的这招毫无用处。
我就在这里等你。

treasure from the Pyramids.

valuables^000000. Consider this as
a test of your strength.

听说刺客公会的最新消息了吗？

scripts.text: News from the Assassin Guild?
scripts.translation: 刺客公会的消息？

scripts.text:
[Assassin]
Hm. You must not have
heard it, then. If you want
to know more about it, you
should speak to Killtin, who
is right next to me. He will
explain everything clearly.
scripts.translation:
[刺客]
嗯，看来还没听说。
想知道详情，就找旁边的基尔廷，他会解释清楚。

scripts.text:
[Assassin]
Hm. Do you know any
Assassins? Tell them
to come here if they
haven't already.
scripts.translation:
[刺客]
你认识其他刺客吗？
他们若还没来过，就介绍来这里。

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's an ancient coffin
with a broken lid that
is slightly ajar. You
momentarily catch a glint
of something shining inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这是一口古老的石棺，破损的棺盖微微敞着。
你瞥见里面有东西闪了一下。^000000

scripts.text: Put your hand inside
scripts.translation: 把手伸进去

scripts.text: Inspect the coffin's opening
scripts.translation: 检查石棺的开口

scripts.text: Lift the lid
scripts.translation: 掀开盖子

scripts.text: Turn the coffin upside down
scripts.translation: 把石棺倒过来

scripts.text: Ignore it
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou carefully put your
hand inside the coffin
and try to retrieve the
shining object that
you had glimpsed.
...............................^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你小心地把手伸进石棺，试着取出刚才瞥见的闪光物。
...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSomething inside
the coffin bit your
hand really hard!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF石棺里有什么东西，狠狠咬了你的手一口！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou try to peek
inside the coffin
through the gap
between the coffin's
edge and the lid.
...............................^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你试着透过棺身与棺盖间的缝隙，窥探里面。
...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou're barely able to
perceive that something
is squirming inside the
coffin, but it's far too dark
to see anything else.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF隐约能看见有东西在石棺里蠕动，可里面太黑，看不清别的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou don't have the
strength to move
something as heavy
as this coffin's lid...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF棺盖太重，你根本挪不动...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou don't have the
strength to turn this
coffin upside down.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你没有足够的力气，将石棺翻过来。^000000

^3355FFThis ancient stone statue
is covered with cracks and
looks close to falling apart.
The glimmer of a shining object
peers out from beneath one of
the feet. The ground appears
soft enough to dig through...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF古老的石像布满裂痕，似乎随时会碎裂。
石像一只脚底下，有东西闪着光。
地面看着很松软，应该挖得动...^000000

scripts.text: Dig to retrieve the shining object
scripts.translation: 挖出闪光物

scripts.text: Ignore it
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs your fingers dig into
the soft ground, it emits^000000
^3355FFa yellow gas that clouds
your senses and briefly
knocks you unconscious.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF手指挖进松软的地面，便有一股^000000^3355FF黄色气体冒出，使你神志模糊，短暂失去了意识。^000000

scripts.text:

^3355FFa yellow gas. However, you

all gas in your lungs in time
to escape its effects. You've

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's something
glimmering beneath
the surface of the water...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF水面下有什么东西在闪闪发光...^000000

scripts.text: Pick it up
scripts.translation: 捡起来

scripts.text: Ignore it
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs soon as you dip your
hand into the water, the
water's freezing chill shoots
up through your arm. You 
better hurry before you freeze!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF手一伸进水中，刺骨的寒意就顺着手臂袭来。
得赶快，否则就冻僵了！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's too late!
Your body has just
been frozen solid.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF太迟了！
你已被冻得动弹不得。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou quickly pick up
the glimmering object
before the water can
freeze you. You obtained
an Aquamarine for Esmille.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF赶在被水冻僵之前，你迅速捞起了闪光物。
你找到了可以带给艾斯米尔的海蓝宝石。^000000
